title: Getting around Rome
body: Most of the historic center is walkable. For anything further, the metro (lines A and B) is fast and cheap — buy tickets at any tabaccheria or via the MyCicero app. Avoid driving; parking is a nightmare and much of the center is restricted (ZTL).

title: Emergency numbers
body: General emergencies: 112. Medical emergencies: 118. Police: 113. If you need help right now and are unsure who to call, 112 connects you to the right service.
